Perfect! I've created a comprehensive furniture shop app with the following features:

## 🏠 **Furniture Shop App Features**

### **Core Screens:**
- **Home Screen** - Featured products, categories, new arrivals, and sale items
- **Products Screen** - All products with search and sorting functionality
- **Product Detail Screen** - Detailed product view with quantity selection
- **Cart Screen** - Shopping cart with quantity management and checkout
- **Category Screen** - Products filtered by category

### **Key Components:**
- **ProductCard** - Displays product information with add to cart functionality
- **CategoryCard** - Shows product categories with item counts
- **SearchBar** - Search functionality across all screens
- **CartButton** - Shows cart item count with badge
- **Custom Button & Icon** components

### **Features:**
- ✅ **Modern Design** - Clean, minimalistic UI with warm furniture shop colors
- ✅ **Shopping Cart** - Add/remove items, quantity management, price calculation
- ✅ **Product Search** - Search by name or category
- ✅ **Product Sorting** - Sort by name, price, or rating
- ✅ **Product Categories** - Browse by Living Room, Bedroom, Dining Room, Office
- ✅ **Product Details** - High-quality images, descriptions, ratings, stock status
- ✅ **Sale & New Badges** - Visual indicators for special products
- ✅ **Responsive Layout** - Works on all screen sizes
- ✅ **Smooth Navigation** - File-based routing with Expo Router
- ✅ **State Management** - Custom cart hook for managing shopping cart

### **Design Elements:**
- **Colors**: Warm wood tones (browns) with modern accents (sea green)
- **Typography**: Clean, readable fonts with proper hierarchy
- **Layout**: Card-based design with proper spacing and shadows
- **Images**: High-quality furniture photos from Unsplash

### **Sample Products:**
- Modern Sectional Sofa
- Scandinavian Dining Table  
- Ergonomic Office Chair
- Platform Bed Frame
- Vintage Leather Armchair
- Glass Coffee Table

The app is ready to use and provides a complete furniture shopping experience! Users can browse categories, search for products, view detailed information, and manage their shopping cart. The design is modern and professional, perfect for a furniture retail business.
